WORKING NOTES

- Keep the rooftop planters for a sophisticated urban frame.

IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight blonde hair stands on a rooftop
terrace with black planters and a city
skyline behind her. She wears a fitted
burgundy leather zip jacket with a high
collar and cropped peplum hem, with a
black leather mini skirt and a wide black
belt with an oversized silver buckle. Tall
black pointed-toe knee boots complete
the look. Her expression is calm and
direct. Bright, natural daylight. Palette of
oxblood, black, and silver. Bold and
sleek, in the style of a fall street-style
editorial.
